title: Regression testing when changing prompt, model or version

videos.script: A regression test does not ask whether a release is good. It asks what the release changed, case by case, on the same questions. {{question}} Run it on the release of the second of October, against the one before. Five cases break, none are fixed. {{history}} And the release is half the price and seven times faster, because it refuses more. That is why it shipped. {{cheaper}} Only the changed cases carry information. McNemar's test asks whether they lean one way more than chance would. Five to nothing gives point zero six. {{paired}} Not significant, and still a release that broke five questions customers ask. A broken case is a fact, not a statistic. {{fact}} A new model changes nothing on the set and doubles the bill. Putting the floor back fixes all five. Doing both breaks a check. {{candidates}} The test refuses runs of different sets, and reports cost and time beside the cases. {{end}}
